objective: Complete commercial launch while keeping security, billing, customer history and provider integrations evidence-backed.
status_summary: Core commercial application code is merged on master: pricing, paid entitlements, customer magic-link access, credits, billing lifecycle hardening, saved sites/history, monitoring, retention, paid surface-report email trigger and deep-report persistence. Railway backend is online. Latest Vercel deployment for b58ca601 is in progress. Remaining blockers are external provider authorization/configuration: HighLevel Products/Payments scope, Resend sender/domain readiness, checkout URLs/product mapping, historical Slack webhook revocation, and final end-to-end paid journey.

latest_verified_milestone.description: Master b58ca601: paid surface reports are customer-owned and emailed through the existing Resend path; paid deep reports are sanitized and persisted into customer history when fetched. CI, CodeQL and Security Audit passed on master; latest CD started.

blockers: HighLevel GHL_API_TOKEN returns HTTP 401 for Products/Payments scope, so live catalog/payment-link provisioning is blocked until provider authorization is repaired.
Resend production sending/domain authorization still requires provider-console verification.
Checkout URLs and STS_GHL_PRODUCT_MAP cannot be finalized until live provider product IDs/links exist.
Historical Slack incoming webhook in Git history remains intentionally unsuppressed until provider revocation is verified.
Final live purchase -> webhook -> entitlement -> login -> scan -> result/email -> return-account journey remains unverified.

tests.summary: Master b58ca601: CI pass, CodeQL pass, Security Audit pass. Secret Scan fails only on the known historical Slack webhook incident pending provider revocation.

deployment.summary: Railway backend is online and healthy; GitHub CD for b58ca601 is currently syncing Vercel environment, then will migrate/verify storage and deploy frontend. Railway GitHub source is pinned to b58ca601 so GitHub CD remains the moving deployment authority.

acceptance_criteria: Repository source scan is complete beyond 60 files and reports explicit incomplete states.
Paid surface scan is customer-owned and can email the PDF report.
Paid deep scans consume credits and persist sanitized report history.
Saved sites, tenant isolation, monitoring and retention are enforced.
Live checkout grants correct entitlement through signed provider webhook.
Customer receives access/email and can complete a paid journey without manual intervention.

active_workstreams.scope: GitHub/CI/CD, release verification, canonical state, remaining application defects.
HighLevel, Resend, Vercel browser/provider console, DNS and Playwright E2E pending logins/authentication.
Repair HighLevel Products/Payments authorization; provision $9/$49/$99 catalog, payment links and webhook.
Verify/repair Resend domain, sender and API authorization.
Revoke historical Slack webhook; then ChatGPT will add the exact gitleaks fingerprint exception.

risks: Provider-console authorization is the critical launch dependency.
Cost harness observed zero reported LLM usage on six verification runs; treat this as an instrumentation gap, not proof of zero model cost.
Railway source and CLI deploy modes are incompatible on one moving branch; source is pinned to prevent duplicate auto-deploy races.
Historical Slack credential must not be broadly suppressed before revocation evidence.
